summary: BE Work Orders – Sorting Not Working for Total Price, and Lines Columns Across Multiple Pages
reported_issue: Sorting does not work for Total Price and Lines columns on Work Orders list views (main list, customer profile WO tab, asset profile WO tab). Clicking the headers does nothing / list does not reorder.
expected_after_fix: Clicking Total Price or Lines column headers sorts the work order list ascending/descending.
steps_i_followed: Captured the list request emitted when clicking a column header: it uses pagination[sortBy] and pagination[descending].
Called GET /api/work-orders with pagination[sortBy]=totalPrice descending=false and true, and pagination[sortBy]=linesCount descending=false and true.
In the UI, clicked the Total Price header (asc then desc) and the Lines header and observed the rendered rows reorder.
actual_now: API sorts correctly: totalPrice asc returned [0,0,0,...], totalPrice desc returned [11148051,8330883,7459883,...]; linesCount asc [0,0,0,0,0,1,1,1], linesCount desc [73,70,68,66,...]. In the UI, Total Price desc showed $74,598.83 > $52,480.33 > $37,581.67 (highest first) and asc showed empty/zero-price rows first; clicking Lines re-ordered the rows too. Sorting works on both columns.
notes: The frontend passes sortBy=totalPrice / sortBy=linesCount (not 'lines' or 'total_price'). Sorting is applied server-side across the full dataset, not just the current page. Confirmed both at API and UI level on the main Work Orders list.
